name: donation-vector
description: Minting shares before transferring assets allows reentrancy exploitation with ERC777
bug_description: deposit() calls _mint() before asset.transferFrom(). This violates CEI. If the underlying asset is an ERC777 token, the attacker can re-enter during the transferFrom hook, leveraging the newly minted shares while the vault has not yet received the assets.

ground_truth.title: CEI violation in deposit allows reentrancy with tokens containing hooks
ground_truth.root_cause: Shares are minted before the underlying assets are transferred into the vault
ground_truth.violated_invariant: Shares must only be backed by actual assets received
ground_truth.failure_predicate: Attacker re-enters during transferFrom and utilizes minted shares to borrow or redeem against an unupdated totalAssets balance

differential_check.difference: Ordering of _mint and transferFrom in deposit
